release.label: RELEASE THE VAULT
release.title: Release the vault
release.body: Close your account and let everything go. This can't be undone.
release.intro: This deletes your account and everything in it, permanently:
release.goneRelics: Every relic: its words, dates, places and weights.
release.goneMedia: Every photo and voice recording, including the files in storage.
release.goneRest: The people and links you saved, your settings, and your sign-in.
release.nothing: There is no undo and no recovery. We can't bring it back, even if you write to us.
release.exportFirst: If you want a copy, close this and export the vault first.
release.confirmBody: Once you confirm, the lamps go out. Everything is deleted now, not in thirty days.
release.failed: The vault wasn't released. Check your signal and try again.
